subcategory_text: Maintenance and repair of organizational assets are performed and logged, with approved and controlled tools.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: MA-2 (Controlled Maintenance), MA-3 (Maintenance Tools)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.7.13 (Equipment maintenance), A.8.9 (Configuration management)
implementation_examples: Perform and log maintenance and repair of organisational assets with approved and controlled tools, with personal-data access minimised during maintenance
Verify that maintenance personnel are cleared for the data they may encounter
Capture evidence of maintenance activities for accountability
assessment_objectives: Determine whether maintenance is logged with assets, personnel, tools, and time
Determine whether maintenance tools are approved and controlled
Determine whether the data exposure during maintenance is minimised
Determine whether unauthorised maintenance is detected
